definition: An attack in which malicious instructions are embedded in input data (such as a webpage or document) to manipulate an AI system's behavior against its intended instructions.
details: Prompt injection is a significant security concern for LLM applications that process untrusted external content, such as agents that browse the web or read documents, since the model may struggle to distinguish trusted instructions from adversarial ones embedded in retrieved content.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Think of it this way: An attack in which malicious instructions are embedded in input data (such as a webpage or document) to manipulate an AI system's behavior against its intended instructions. And here is the clever part: Prompt injection is a significant security concern for LLM applications that process untrusted external content, such as agents that browse the web or read documents, since the model may struggle to distinguish trusted instructions from adversarial ones embedded in retrieved content. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is Prompt Injection — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
